🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. SPY in RECOVERY (1W: +0.38% | 1M: -0.28%) RECOVERY and VXX (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +5.51%) CORRECTION → flat risk ratios, while HYG (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND confirm credit stability.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress muted: HYG (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND → → flat direction. Volatility mixed: VXX (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +5.51%) CORRECTION and bonds bid: TLT (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +1.07%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral overall: dollar and yield signals flat in the kit while TLT (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +1.07%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising denotes duration demand. SPY/TLT reads mixed with SPY (1W: +0.38% | 1M: -0.28%) RECOVERY versus TLT ABOVE TREND.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals leading: XLE (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +14.81%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, XLB (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +9.64%) ABOVE TREND and XLP (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +9.97%) ABOVE TREND showing broad commodity/defensive support. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -2.46%) RECOVERY — style: Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?  
Global pockets outperforming: EWJ (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +1.68% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND, FXI (1W: +2.09% | 1M: +0.46%) ABOVE TREND. US large-cap mixed with SPY (1W: +0.38% | 1M: -0.28%) RECOVERY while QQQ (1W: -0.82% | 1M: -2.42%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Small-cap strength: IWM (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND indicates risk appetite; thematic/crypto impaired with ARKK (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -10.00%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -23.83%) BELOW TREND showing speculative retrenchment.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Precious metals and solar/materials bid: GLD (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and TAN (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +16.48%) ABOVE TREND. Industrial metals mixed with CPER (1W: -3.07% | 1M: +0.50%) CORRECTION — commodity strength but with short-term dispersion.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy robust: XLE (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +14.81%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +11.15%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Natural gas divergent: UNG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: +16.63%) CORRECTION — large 1W pullback vs 1M strength.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (9/11) and multiple cyclical ETFs ABOVE TREND (XLE, XLB, XLP, GLD) provide confirmation for a neutral-to-positive backdrop. DIVERGENCE: Minor divergence across timeframes (SPY, XLK, UNG show 1W vs 1M mismatch) — monitor momentum rather than assume regime change.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposure (XLE, XLB, TAN) while reducing exposure to lagging tech names (XLK) and speculative crypto/thematic ETFs (IBIT, ARKK). Bonds/TLT showing strength—monitor duration exposure as a hedge.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +14.81%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +9.64%) ABOVE TREND — if commodity momentum persists. BEARISH: XLY (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -4.89%) BELOW TREND and XLK (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -2.46%) RECOVERY — watch discretionary and tech weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +11.15%) ABOVE TREND if safe-haven/energy bids continue. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: +16.63%) CORRECTION and SLV (1W: -4.61% | 1M: +1.42%) CORRECTION on short-term profit-taking.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +5.51%) CORRECTION — watch ~20 for complacency signal. HYG (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND — HYG/LQD stability is key for risk appetite. XLK (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -2.46%) RECOVERY vs IWM (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND is a useful style pivot to monitor.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive.  
Cyclicals and commodities showing relative strength (XLE (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +14.81%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +9.64%) ABOVE TREND, GLD (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: time-frame divergences in tech and speculative ETFs (XLK (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -2.46%) RECOVERY; IBIT (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -23.83%) BELOW TREND) — monitor momentum.
